scope: Canonical billing link and persisted return-contract change. Reviewed affected source diffs, complete reconciled owning guides, database permissions/retry boundaries, and local browser evidence. Broad fingerprints detect drift; they are not an exhaustive re-audit of unchanged subsystems.

domain_conclusions.billing: Canonical task map, sole Credits form, finite middleware compatibility, stored Stripe return contracts and restricted portal align with current guides. Obsolete page/component source removed; runtime identifiers and evidence retained.
domain_conclusions.database: One nullable constrained private column, no default/backfill/grant change. Migration before writer; rollback preserves return evidence. 113-pair static check and fresh DB/plan/credit fixtures pass; production unapplied.
domain_conclusions.access: Alias redirects occur before page rendering and forward allowlisted public parameters. No payment, user, developer-preview or administrator authority is introduced. 34 session tests and raw unauthorized billing requests pass. Removed unused API-key paywall cannot mint credit or unlock access.
domain_conclusions.sites: Paid proof and fair-use authority unchanged. Upgrade/navigation entries use Plan, new checkout returns persist Plan; paid-access guide reconciled. Plan DB suite including entitlement and lifecycle tests passes.
domain_conclusions.images: Only existing upgrade-link destinations and URL guide changed. No image generation, library or admission change; image DB suite not rerun for this navigation-only scope.
domain_conclusions.broccolidb: Two existing governor recovery URLs now target Credits; algorithm, quota state and persistence unchanged. Full broader BroccoliDB suite not rerun. Search intent mapping has focused regression tests; no latency or model claim certified.
domain_conclusions.client-efficiency: Both search catalogs route task intents accurately. Native links and six-page hierarchy retained. Browser history, account drafts, retry hints and pending receipts verified. Existing reading/home design guides updated for Plan destination only.
domain_conclusions.delivery: Production validation build, 1404-source parity and 643-asset private-marker scan pass. Vault framework redirect narrowed only for deposit alias. Release and rollback guides include migration prerequisite; no deployment or live acceptance.
domain_conclusions.knowledge: Active source additions mapped. Deleted source paths no longer have impossible registry patterns; their ownership and deletion list retained in release evidence. Remaining unmapped paths are deleted presentation, generated inventories, dated evidence and existing detector config. Original incident evidence and ADR statuses retained.

limits: No deployment, live database migration, Stripe configuration write, real payment, refund, cancellation or provider message in this pass.
Hosted signed-in navigation and Stripe settlement require separate post-release acceptance.
Compiled private-marker and fixture HTTP scans do not certify the whole live site. Axe scoped to main/aside, no physical device or screen-reader certification.
No claims about new commercial terms, tax readiness or reduced transaction lock duration. Earlier follow-ups remain separate.
Existing unrelated overdue incident actions remain open.
